en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing views of Assisi. The upper part presents a wide view of the hill town with its basilica complex stretched along the slope. To the right is a broader landscape labeled "Panorama" with fields and small figures in the foreground and the town on the hill in the background. At the bottom left, framed decoratively, is a view of a medieval fortress labeled "La Rocca (XIV secolo)". Decorative text and a round stamp‑like mark with the letters "A. C. T." also appear.
